# langsmith_usage_limits (Data Source)

Lists the LangSmith usage limits configured for the current workspace, or for every workspace in the organization when `org_scope` is set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Usage limits for the current workspace.
data "langsmith_usage_limits" "workspace" {}

# Usage limits across every workspace in the organization.
data "langsmith_usage_limits" "org" {
  org_scope = true
}

output "workspace_limits" {
  value = {
    for l in data.langsmith_usage_limits.workspace.limits : l.limit_type => l.limit_value
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `org_scope` (Boolean) When `true`, lists usage limits across the whole organization (`/usage-limits/org`) instead of only the current workspace.
- `workspace_id` (String) If set, overrides the provider-level `workspace_id` for all API calls made by this data source. Only meaningful for the default workspace-scoped listing; ignored by the API when `org_scope` is `true`.

### Read-Only

- `limits` (Attributes List) The usage limits. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--limits))

<a id="nestedatt--limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `limits`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the usage limit.
- `limit_type` (String) The type of usage limit (e.g. `monthly_traces`, `monthly_longlived_traces`).
- `limit_value` (Number) The limit value.
- `updated_at` (String) The last update timestamp.
- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace the limit applies to (returned by the API as `tenant_id`).
